portfolio_status.zh: 当前持仓与风险敞口：持有ETH多头（亏损-30.38）、BTC空头（盈利22.82）、DOGE多头（持平），共3个头寸，已达上限；总风险敞口约50% NAV（基于持仓名义价值），符合牛市（BTC>SMA50）下的100% NAV限制，但需谨慎新增。
portfolio_status.en: Current portfolio exposure & risk status: Holding ETH long (loss -30.38), BTC short (profit 22.82), DOGE long (flat), total of 3 positions, at the limit; total exposure is approximately 50% NAV (based on notional values), within the 100% NAV limit for a bullish market (BTC > SMA50), but caution is needed for new additions.

reflection.zh: 历史反思：近期胜率0%，但模式有效（如融资费率Z-score极端时的均值回归），本次决策强化了基于拥挤交易（轧空/轧多）的剧本，避免过度依赖Qlib高分（可能反映过度乐观），并优先管理现有持仓。
reflection.en: Historical reflection: Recent win rate is 0%, but patterns are effective (e.g., mean reversion with extreme funding Z-scores), this decision reinforces scenarios based on crowded trades (short/long squeezes), avoids over-reliance on high Qlib scores (which may reflect over-optimism), and prioritizes managing existing positions.

entry_reason.en: Hold reason: Matches 【Mean Reversion】 scenario, funding Z-score 131.70% extremely high indicates crowded longs with long squeeze risk, but daily bullish trend (price > SMA50) and RSI 36.27 oversold provide support; stop-loss at 2100 not triggered, awaiting reversal or stop.

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破2100（基于ATR 21.43和支撑位），或融资费率Z-score降至<50%（拥挤缓解），或日线趋势转熊（价格跌破SMA50 2040.28）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 2100 (based on ATR 21.43 and support), or funding Z-score drops <50% (crowding eases), or daily trend turns bearish (price < SMA50 2040.28).
